prerequisites: Ability to read and understand documentation written in English (recommended).

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to select, design, deploy, integrate, and manage communication networks and infrastructures in an organization.
Understand the architectures of corporate networks and the technologies for their interconnection to the Internet.
Design corporate networks taking into account economic, security, and quality of service issues.
Understand the services and protocols that allow configuring and managing corporate networks.

syllabus_topics: Configuring access lists in corporate networks
Design and traffic analysis in a corporate network
Integration and interconnection of wired and wireless networks within an organization
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, the final grade is calculated as 0.25 x Group Work + 0.10 x Individual Assignments + 0.40 x Laboratory Practices + 0.25 x Final Exam. To pass, each part must be successfully completed. Group and individual assignments can only be completed in the ordinary call, and attendance to oral defense sessions is mandatory for group work. For the extraordinary call, group work and individual assignments scores are maintained if approved in the ordinary call; otherwise, they receive 0. Laboratory practice scores are maintained if approved; if not, a practical exam with a minimum score of 5 out of 10 is required. A final knowledge test with a minimum score of 5 out of 10 is also required. The final grade for the extraordinary call is 0.25 x Final Exam + 0.4 x Laboratory Practices + 0.35 x Assignments Score. For differentiated evaluation, a face-to-face exam on theoretical and practical content is given, with the final grade calculated as 0.7 x Theory Exam + 0.3 x Practical Exam.
